id./param/region/r008.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dab: "But monsters attacked and it fell overnight, and now it lies in ruins. Past glory is barely visible...
id./param/region/r008.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dbc: "...And the souls of those who died here, in deep sorrow, haven't returned to Yggdrasil and still linger here.

id./param/region/r008.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ddd: "Undead Men appear at night, wishing for the homeland's impossible restoration... and keep wandering this land.

tm.「この先に 進みたければ\n まずは 他のふたつの試練で チカラをつけて\n ネ: "To go beyond, first build strength in the other two trials and earn Lord Nelsen's recognition.
tm.「この聖なる苗木に 手をかざすと\n 勇者の試練に 挑むことができるぞ。: "Hold your hand over this sacred sapling to take on the Luminary's Trial.
tm.「勇者の試練は ３つの試練の中でも\n もっとも 難しい試練だからな。\n 挑む: "The Luminary's Trial is the hardest of the three, so be prepared if you take it on.
tm.「ぷるるん ぷるるん！\n ここは 英雄王ネルセンさまが\n 迷宮に挑む人のため: "Boing boing! This is the Village of Trials, which the Hero-King Nelsen built for those who take on the labyrinth!
tm.「お兄ちゃんたち ここに来るまでに\n すっごく 疲れたでしょ！\n ぜひ この: "Big brothers, you must be so tired getting here! Please rest in this village!
tm.「ヘイ ヨー！ こんな場所に\n 魔物がいて おどろいただろう！\n でも そん: "Hey yo! A monster here must have startled you! But no need to be so scared!
tm.「オレたちは ネルセンの兄貴に 成敗されて\n 生まれ変わった いい魔物なんだ！: "We're good monsters reborn after Brother Nelsen beat us! We won't hurt humans!
tm.「ヘイ ヨー！ あんちゃん 知ってたかい？\n この里の長老は 神の民の里を治め: "Hey yo! Bro, did you know? This village's elder is the twin brother of Lord Igortap, who rules Havens Above!
tm.「オレは イゴルタプさまを 見たことないが\n 生き写しのように そっくりらしい: "I've never seen Lord Igortap, but they say they look exactly alike! I'd love to see him someday!
tm.「ヘイ ヨー あんちゃん！\n ネルセンさまの試練を 乗り越え\n すべての恐怖: "Hey yo, bro! You overcame Lord Nelsen's trial and conquered every fear!
tm.「自分の中にある恐怖を 乗り越える……。\n クチで言うのは たやすいけどさ\n: "Overcoming the fear in yourself... Easy to say, but hardly anyone can do it!
tm.「勇者のチカラも スゲーけどさ\n あんちゃんの 本当の強さは\n 何者にも負け: "The Luminary's power is awesome, but your true strength must be a heart that never loses to anything!
tm.「ほよよ～ん！ ここまで 来れたってことは\n あなたが ネルセンさまの待ち望ん: "Ho-yo~n! Making it this far means you're the Luminary Lord Nelsen has awaited!
tm.「さすが ユーシャさまだけあって\n 勇ましいカオつきを してるよ～ん！\n か: "As expected of the Luminary, you've got a valiant face, ho-yo~n! So cool, ho-yo~n!
tm.「ほよよ～ん！ この迷宮は ネルセンさまが\n 作ったんだけど 彼が亡くなった後: "Ho-yo~n! Lord Nelsen made this labyrinth, but even after he died we kept improving it little by little, ho-yo~n.
tm.「いくら ユーシャさまでも\n そう簡単には 制覇できないはずだから\n 挑むな: "Even a Luminary can't conquer it easily, so be prepared if you take it on, ho-yo~n.
tm.「ほよよ～ん！ 迷宮を制覇したのかよ～ん！\n オイラたちが 何百年もかけて 改: "Ho-yo~n! You conquered the labyrinth! We improved it for hundreds of years, and you conquered it, I'm astonished, ho-yo~n!
tm.「でも 最後まで到達する人が いなかったら\n 長い時間かけて 改良した意味が: "But if no one reached the end, all that time improving it would be meaningless, ho-yo~n. I'm glad the Luminary came, ho-yo~n.
tm.「かつて この地には\n バンデルフォンという王国がありました。\n 四大国と肩: "This land once held a kingdom called Champs Sauvages. It was a great nation on par with the four great powers.
tm.「ですが 魔物の襲撃を受け 国は一夜にして滅び\n 現在では 廃墟となっておりま: "But monsters attacked and it fell overnight, and now it lies in ruins. Past glory is barely visible...
tm.「……そして この地で亡くなった方の魂は\n 深い悲しみから 命の大樹へ還ること: "...And the souls of those who died here, in deep sorrow, haven't returned to Yggdrasil and still linger here.
tm.「祖国を失った悲しみ 守れなかった悲しみ……。\n 深い悲しみの念によって 行き: "Grief at losing and failing to protect the homeland left souls with nowhere to go. They became monsters called Undead Men.
tm.「アンデッドマンは 夜になると現れ\n かなわない祖国の復興を 願い……\n こ: "Undead Men appear at night, wishing for the homeland's impossible restoration... and keep wandering this land.
tm.「旅の方……。あなた方に お願いがあります。\n どうか アンデッドマンとなった: "Traveler... I have a favor. Could you give peaceful rest to the one who became an Undead Man?
tm.「そうですか……。致し方ありません。\n どうやら 他に用が おありのようですね: "I see... It can't be helped. You seem to have other business. I'll wait for the time you can lend us your strength.
tm.「引き受けて頂けるとは ありがとうございます。\n その者に 安らかな眠りを与え: "Thank you for taking this on. To grant that soul peaceful rest, you need the pep power Holy Prayer.
tm.「聖なる祈りは……そうですね。\n あなたと そちらの金髪の女性であれば\n 使: "Holy Prayer... Let me see. You and the blonde woman there should be able to use it.
tm.「どうか 夜 バンデルフォンの廃墟に向かい\n 聖なる祈りを使って アンデッドマ: "Go to the Champs Sauvages ruins at night, and use Holy Prayer to defeat the Undead Man and grant him rest.
tm.「どうか れんけい技の聖なる祈りを使って\n アンデッドマンを倒し\n 安らかな: "Please use the pep power Holy Prayer to defeat the Undead Man and grant him peaceful rest.
tm.「アンデッドマンが現れるのは 夜……。\n 夜 バンデルフォンの廃墟に現れます。: "The Undead Man appears at night... in the ruins of Champs Sauvages. Please be careful...
tm.「声が……。\n 声が 聞こえなくなりました。\n 亡国を憂うような 悲しみの声: "The voice... I can't hear the voice anymore. That sorrowful voice grieving for the fallen country...
tm.「どうやら アンデッドマンとなった者に\n 安らかな眠りを 与えたようですね……: "It seems you granted peaceful rest to the one who became an Undead Man... Traveler, thank you truly.
tm.「こちらは 私の気持ちとなります。\n どうか 遠慮せず受け取ってください。: "This is a token of my gratitude. Please accept it without hesitation.
tm.「さまよい続ける魂が 命の大樹に還れず\n 魔物となるという現象は\n この地だ: "Souls wandering unable to return to Yggdrasil and becoming monsters occurs not only here but elsewhere.
tm.「願わくば すべての魂が 自然の理にしたがい\n 命の大樹に 還れるように……\: "I pray for the time when every soul can return to Yggdrasil as nature intends.
tm.「ヘイ！ そこの あんた！\n 人生 急いでも いいことはないぜ！: "Hey! You there! Rushing through life gets you nowhere!
tm.「たまには 超天才吟遊詩人と評判の\n オレの歌声に 耳をかたむけたりするくらい: "Sometimes you need the leeway to listen to my voice, the renowned super-genius bard!
tm.「じつは 命と魂をけずって 書きあげた\n 大事な楽譜を 魔物がはびこる\n 森: "Truth is, I left the precious score I wrote with my life and soul in the monster-infested forest.
tm.「あの楽譜には オレの心が！ 人生が！\n そして 世界に伝えたい メッセージが: "That score holds my heart! My life! And the message I want to share with the world! All of it!
tm.「命より大事な楽譜を 置き忘れるなんて\n オレのバカヤロウ！ 大バカヤロウ！！: "Forgetting a score more precious than life, damn me! Damn me! This anger alone might write another song!
tm.「だが オレは吟遊詩人……武器は 持たねぇ。\n オレが 持っていいのは 楽器だ: "But I'm a bard... I carry no weapons. I may hold only instruments. I can't beat monsters to retrieve it!
tm.「あんた ウデが立ちそうだよな。頼む！\n オレの楽譜を！ オレの命がけで書いた: "You look capable. Please! My score! The song I wrote with my life! Help me get it back!!
tm.「くっ！ オレの 熱い気持ちが\n あんたには 伝わらないっていうのか！\n だ: "Damn! My burning feelings don't reach you! But I can't force you... what a shame.
tm.「本当か！？ ありがてぇ……よろしく 頼むぜ！\n 楽譜は ユグノア地方の 西の: "Really!? Bless you... I'm counting on you! The score should be left in the mountain cabin in the western forest of Dundrasil.
tm.「失った楽譜を 書き直しても\n きっと カンペキな歌にはならねぇ……。\n そ: "Even if I rewrite the lost score, it won't be a perfect song... It's no longer the same thing.
tm.「あんたと あんたの仲間を オレは信じる！\n オレの楽譜を 取り戻してくれ！！: "I believe in you and your companions! Get my score back!!
tm.「オレの大切な 新曲の楽譜を\n ユグノア地方の 西の森にある\n 山小屋に 置: "I left my precious new score in the mountain cabin in the western forest of Dundrasil...
tm.「オレからは 何も言うことはねぇ。\n あんたのことを 信じてるからな。\n …: "I've nothing to say. I believe in you. ...Did you do it?
tm.「全部 あんたに まかせたと言った。\n だから 待つさ。あんたが オレの楽譜を: "I said I'd leave it all to you. So I'll wait for you to get my score back and return here!
tm.「……オオオ 悪にくじけぬ この勇気！\n 背中を預けた 友のため\n キズつく: "...Ohh, courage that bows to no evil! For a friend who guarded my back, I'd bear any wound!
tm.「愛の絆が 世界を結び\n 正義の叫びが 邪悪な敵を討つー\n ああ 偉大なる者: "The bond of love ties the world; the cry of justice strikes evil foes! Ah, the great one, whose name is Luminary!!
tm.「おっと つい クチずさんじまった。\n 間違いないぜ オレの楽譜……オレの歌だ: "Oops, I hummed it unawares. No doubt, it's my score... my song.
tm.「オレは この歌で 希望は まだあるって\n みんなに そう伝えたかったんだ。\: "With this song I wanted to tell everyone there's still hope. Yes... the hope called the Luminary.
tm.「どこにいるか わからないが……\n それでも 太陽は 毎朝 昇ってくる。\n: "I don't know where he is... but the sun still rises every morning. Like the sun, the Luminary drives away darkness!
tm.「オレのように 勇者を信じてる人を\n 元気づけるための 大切な楽譜を あんたは: "You got back the precious score that cheers people who believe in the Luminary like me... Let me thank you.
tm.「なあ あんた。\n どこかで 勇者に会ったら 伝えてくれ。\n 勇者を 信じて: "Hey, if you meet the Luminary somewhere, tell him someone believes in him!
tm.「勇者が不幸を呼ぶとか ウソっぱちだ！\n オレは 信じない！ オレは 勇者を信: "That the Luminary brings misfortune is a lie! I don't believe it! I believe in the Luminary! This song sings that.
tm.「さあ！ 歌うぜーっ！\n あんたが 取り戻してくれた この歌で\n 世界を ひ: "Now! I sing! With this song you got back for me, I'll unite the world!!
